info.name: idempotency-key-registry Postman Collection
info.description:
Distributed idempotency key registry for safe request retries across 
microservices. Prevents duplicate side effects when clients retry due to 
network failures, timeouts, or user double-clicks. Coordinates concurrent 
requests to the same key, caches completed responses for instant replay, 
and guarantees at-most-once execution of critical operations like payments, 
orders, and refunds.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

variable.description: Override with the base URL of the deployed Apigee proxy.
The idempotency key to look up.

item.name: Reserve a new idempotency key before processing a request

request.description:
Reserve a new idempotency key before processing a request

Responses:
- 201: Key reserved — caller may proceed with the operation.
- 200: Key already exists — either IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED (replay cached
response), or FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH. The caller should NOT proceed.

- 400: Invalid request payload or missing required fields.
- 409: Fingerprint mismatch — key reused with different payload.
- 500: Internal server error.
